player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} ({role}) a {num_rounds}-hpang Matching Pennies mali kawp.
- Hpang shagu, [heads] shagu [tails] (shagu [h], [t]) sha rai.
- Nanhte akyu hte nang hpang shai wa, Player 0 hpang shai; shing nrai, Player 1 hpang shai.
Nanhte akyu hpe [heads] shagu [tails] hku rai.

message.round_match: Masha 0 na {choice0} sha hkam; Masha 1 na {choice1} sha hkam. Hpang maga jaw -> Masha 0 gaw shanu
message.round_mismatch: Masha 0 na {choice0} sha hkam; Masha 1 na {choice1} sha hkam. Hpang maga de -> Masha 1 gaw shanu

outcome.p0_wins: Dai shaloi, player 0 gaw raundi law htum lu ai.
outcome.p1_wins: Hpang jahtum 1 gaw kaja ai hpang grai masai.
outcome.draw: Yawng jahtum hta, ginsup ai lam gaw dang hkra sha re.
